title: Vertiv buys data center rack maker Great Lakes for $200M

sources.quote: today announced it has entered into an agreement to acquire the Great Lakes Data Racks & Cabinets family of companies (collectively “Great Lakes”) for $200 million.
today announced the successful completion of its previously reported intent to acquire the Great Lakes Data Racks & Cabinets family of companies

explain: Vertiv paid $200 million for Great Lakes, a Pennsylvania maker of the metal racks and cabinets that hold servers in data centers, including racks built for dense AI hardware. The deal closed in August 2025.
